dogecoin.text:
#Dogecoin just spiked again, almost to $0.15/Doge. But then it immediately fell back down almost to where that spike started (around $0.12). 

Someone is pouring a lot of money into making Doge spike to drive up the value, in the hope that it will keep that level.

Okay, just checked. Yeah, #Dogecoin is dropping right now. It's just above $0.11/Doge right now and falling. I'm guessing it'll fall back down to about $0.08-$0.09 before evening out. But who knows what'll happen.

Suddenly $1/Doge by year's end doesn't seem so far fetched.

Holy shit. Yesterday #Dogecoin was at about $0.06 a Doge; now its above $0.11 and still climbing.

WTF is going on!?!?!!!

I said this less than an hour ago.

#Dogecoin just blew past $0.15 and is now around $0.17/Doge.

#Dogecoin is knocking on $0.15 right now.

Unbelievable.
